analysis.summary: Anlon Technology Solutions reported strong operational and financial performance for H2 and FY26, with revenue growing 111% year-on-year to INR105.92 crores for the full year. Manufacturing and assembly emerged as a core revenue driver, contributing approximately 50% of FY26 revenue, while the order book stood at INR110.15 crores as of March 31, 2026. Management highlighted robust demand driven by government initiatives like Make in India and airport modernization, and plans to utilize a recent fundraise to scale up bidding capacities for large infrastructure projects. Anlon Technology Solutions reported significant milestones in FY26, including the assembly and supply of India's first Make in India Turntable Ladder with Rescue Lift and strategic partnerships with Rosenbauer International A.G and Bucher Municipal. The company achieved a strong order book of approximately Rs.

guidance.claim: The company stated that with Rs.110.15 crore orders in hand along with forthcoming orders, it is positioned for sustained profitable growth.
guidance.quote: With Rs.110.15 crore orders in hand as on March 31, 2026, along with forthcoming orders, we’re positioned for sustained profitable growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects to introduce new vehicles which were earlier not imported due to higher costs.
guidance.quote: Given the growth in our target industry we expect to introduce new vehicles which were earlier not imported due to higher costs.

guidance.claim: The company is planning to achieve 30% to 35% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: And with the market outlook in these three segments that are growing, I would say we must be able to achieve something like 30% to 35% growth in FY '27.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry outlook remains highly encouraging with increasing airport modernization and infrastructure expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry outlook also remains highly encouraging, increasing airport modernization process, infrastructure expansion, urban development initiatives and rising focus on operational safety continue to create strong long-term opportunities for engineering-led companies like Anlon, especially under the government, Make in India initiative and also the, Swachh Bharat Abhiyan projects across the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated they are struggling to keep up with the demand of the market due to delayed translation of quality into practical purchase rules.
demand_outlook.quote: Now we are struggling to keep up with the demand of the market. And this reaction will take us at least one more year to meet the piled up demand, which was a little bit delayed on translating the quality into practical purchase rules.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company expects to introduce new vehicles given the growth in the target industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Given the growth in our target industry we expect to introduce new vehicles which were earlier not imported due to higher costs.

demand_outlook.claim: The Government of India intends to privatize 11 more airports, bringing the total to around 30 airports for development.
demand_outlook.quote: There will be 12 more, 11 or 12 more new airports that will be privatized. The Government of India has made up their minds to privatize further 11 more airports and this will take the total to around 30 airports for development in the coming couple of years, which makes India one of the fastest growing aviation markets.

capex_expansion.claim: M/S ROSENBAUER International A.G Austria decided to get a series of fire engines manufactured from Anlon's Bangalore facility.
capex_expansion.quote: The year 2026 is another significant year for us, as our long-term associates, M/S ROSENBAUER International A.G Austria, has made a strategic decision to join hands with Anlon for getting a series of fire engines manufactured from Anlon’s Bangalore facility.

capex_expansion.claim: Anlon and M/S BUCHER Municipal took a joint decision to manufacture their Sewage Cleaner machines in India.
capex_expansion.quote: Another major milestone achieved by Anlon in FY26 is joint decision with M/S BUCHER Municipal, Switzerland to manufacture their world-renowned Sewage Cleaner machines in India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred INR1.49 lakhs toward the construction of an office building that is under construction as of September 30, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: We have incurred an amount of INR1.49 lakhs during the period towards the construction of the office building which is under construction as on 30th September 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: An amount of INR3.7 crores was incurred toward the manufacturing of motor vehicles (sweeping machines) for demo and hire purposes, classified under capital work-in-progress.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the company incurred INR3.7 crores towards manufacturing of the motor vehicles which are nothing but the sweeping machines that will be used for demo purpose as well as for giving it to the customers on hire basis. So, these trucks which were under the production, so this is also part of the capital working progress.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H2 FY26 remained healthy at around 19.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin remained healthy at around 19.4% and against 18.8% in H2 FY25.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for FY26 improved to 19.60% from 19.55% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: while EBITDA margin improved to 19.60% from 19.55% in FY25.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved to 13.10% compared to 12.92% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 13.10% compared to 12.92% in FY25.

margins_costs.claim: The blended margin in Manufacturing and Assembly is around 15% due to initial projects taken at lower margins to grab the market.
margins_costs.quote: So, we have a blended margin of around 15% in Manufacturing & Assembly.

margins_costs.claim: The Distribution business has a margin of around 20% in the current year.
margins_costs.quote: But in the Distribution business, we have a margin of around 20% in the current year.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the average difference between imported equipment and made in India equipment is around 30%.
margins_costs.quote: Average difference between imported equipment and made in India equipment is around 30%.

margins_costs.claim: Refurbishment of trucks generally carries slightly higher margins, which contributed to a modest improvement in overall profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Generally, refurbishment of these trucks carries slightly higher margins. This contributed to a modest improvement in the overall profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material consumption was lower at INR1.87 crores due to better inventory utilization.
margins_costs.quote: And our raw material consumption lowers at INR1.87 crores due to the better inventory utilization.

margins_costs.claim: Overall gross margins benefited from favorable inventory movement.
margins_costs.quote: And our overall gross margins benefited from the favorable inventory movement.

orders_capacity.claim: As of March 31, 2026, the company's total order book stood at approximately INR110.15 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: As of March 31, 2026, the company's total order book stood at approximately INR110.15 crores, providing strong revenue visibility going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported a total order book of approximately Rs. 110.15 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Total order book of ~₹110.15 Cr as of March 31, 2026

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the INR115 crores in orders on hand, INR18.83 crores pertains to operations and maintenance of airport airside equipment to be billed over 5 years, with the balance of INR95 crores to be billed by FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR115 cores, if you see, there is an order for about INR18.83 cores, which is for the first time, we are going to do the operations and maintenance of the general vehicles and other equipment of entire airport, airside. So, this is actually we will be billing over the 5 years. Apart from that, the balance, whatever it is there, INR95 crores, it will be billed by FY '27.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently pitching in for new orders worth more than INR70 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are about, I think, currently more than INR70 crores worth we are now pitching in for the new orders.

orders_capacity.claim: The present manufacturing facility has a capacity of a six-week assembly time for seven vehicles.
orders_capacity.quote: But at the present center, we can do six weeks assembly time, seven vehicles.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operations improved to a net inflow of INR5.89 crores during the half year ended September 30, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: And if you see our cash flow from operations improved significantly from the net outflow of INR9.2 crores during the off year ended 30th September 2024 and a net outflow of INR16.7 crores for the year ended 31st March 2025 to a net inflow of INR5.89 crores during the last half year 30th September 2025, which is reflecting improved cash generation from the operations.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will be fully tied up with fulfilling the domestic market for at least the next year to 1.5 years.
management_commitments.quote: So therefore, next year at least, 1 year, 1.5 years, we are fully tied up with fulfilling the domestic market.

management_commitments.claim: The company does not undertake to make any announcement in case forward looking statements become materially incorrect in future or update any forward looking statements.
management_commitments.quote: The Company does not undertake to make any announcement in case any of these forward looking statements become materially incorrect in future or update any forward looking statements made from time to time by or on behalf of the Company.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to convert its current manufacturing facility into an R&D and competence center and look for space for customized manufacturing.
management_commitments.quote: And the facility that we are at the moment manufacturing, we will convert that into an R&D and competence center. We are looking for space that can be built for customized manufacturing.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
